verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent extensibility. ZCode has a plugin system, documented through an Excalidraw canvas-collaboration example covering plugin install/update and page APIs (zcode-gh-6). It can also be invoked remotely from WeChat, Feishu, or Telegram (zcode-docs-3), but that is task triggering rather than pulling workspace context into the agent. Missing for 10: any documented connectors or MCP-client support for Jira, Slack, or Google Drive; evidence that external tool data feeds into agent context; and independent or hands-on corroboration of such integrations.
